title: GatewaySecretHiddenEvent
description: WP-103: one of the run's sandbox gateways (the egress proxy, or the model gateway behind it) found a credential shape in the body of the run's model call, replaced it with a fixed placeholder and let the call go on: the body is the run's own context going to the org's model, and public pages the run read carry documentation examples of these shapes. The gateway reports it with the run's own gateway token; Node writes it on the run's stream, once per run, gateway and kind, and at most a fixed number per run. The kind only: never the value, the request's content, URL path or query. A shape in a header, a URL or a tool call is refused instead (`gateway.refused`). Folds ignore it; it is an audit record.

gateway.description: egress: the sandbox's egress proxy; model: the model gateway.

kind.description: The credential shape hidden: a kind of the token patterns (vectors/token-patterns.json), or policy_pattern for one of the egress policy's own patterns.

attemptId.description: The attempt the reporting token was issued for, from the verified token.
